definitions.population_deviation: Maximum absolute district deviation from state resident population / K; percentages use that fractional ideal.
definitions.runtime: Timed pipeline including source work, solve, correction, validation and export; excludes Python startup. No sum of concurrent plan times is presented as batch wall time.
definitions.memory: Per-process Windows peak working set, excluding browser, server, parent and other concurrent workers.
definitions.percentiles: Plan-weighted distribution; linear interpolation for p90; unique state/K plans overall. Anchor subsets may reuse the same plan.
definitions.complete: Terminal validated graph/polygon output; no population tolerance was imposed as an acceptance gate.
definitions.payload: Saved gzip geometry/index bytes, not measured browser request totals; excludes JavaScript and other page assets.

limitations: Saved audit fields checked; no new geometric or graph reconstruction.
Compressed maps checked for existence and size, not decompressed again.
Process command-line enumeration via CIM unavailable; queue and all state locks independently acquired and released.

map_payload_audit.statistics_unit: measured gzip artifact bytes; one observation per distinct state/district-count plan, county rows repeated across plans
caveats: Artifact byte counts exclude benchmark and map manifest JSON, HTML/JavaScript/CSS, background basemap assets, HTTP headers and other network costs; not measured initial browser load or memory.

National totals include only valid complete plans in this 49-state suite; Kansas is excluded. Topology exceptions are absent at all anchors; Maryland and Virginia are additionally absent at House1000.
State entry means simplified state district outlines plus county detail index, excluding detailed blocks until county selection.
County detail is full-precision source geometry GeoJSON, not vector tiles. Large counties still need multiple MiB compressed.

District outlines are display simplifications, not authoritative block assignments. Nominal state/national tolerances are30m/250m for shared-edge coverage simplification; these are square-root removed-triangle areas, not strict maximum displacement guarantees.

schema.outlines: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; properties district_id, population, block_count; IDs district-{zero_based_id}
schema.detail: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; properties geoid, district_id, population; feature ID=GEOID; full source geometry
schema.index: JSON bbox and counties containing bounds, counts, population, logical/gzip paths and raw/gzip byte sizes
